# Ezekiel 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of man, make-known to-Jerusalem her-abominations,

**3** and-say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH to-Jerusalem: Your-origin and-your-birth [are] from-the-land-of the-Canaanite; your-father [was] the-Amorite and-your-mother a-Hittite.

**4** And-your-birth — on-the-day you-were-born your-navel-cord was-not-cut, and-in-water you-were-not-washed for-cleansing, and-you-were-not-salted, and-you-were-not-wrapped.

**5** No eye pitied you to-do for-you any-of-these, to-have-compassion upon-you; and-you-were-cast upon the-face-of the-field in-the-loathing-of your-soul on-the-day you-were-born.

**6** And-I-passed by-you and-saw-you wallowing in-your-blood, and-I-said to-you in-your-blood, 'Live!' And-I-said to-you in-your-blood, 'Live!'

**7** A-myriad, like-the-growth-of the-field, I-made-you, and-you-grew and-became-great and-came into-[the]-ornament-of ornaments; breasts were-formed and-your-hair grew, but-you [were] naked and-bare.

**8** And-I-passed by-you and-saw-you, and-behold, your-time [was the]-time-of loves; and-I-spread My-skirt over-you and-covered your-nakedness; and-I-swore to-you and-entered into-a-covenant with-you," declares the-Lord YHWH, "and-you-became Mine.

**9** And-I-washed-you with-water, and-I-rinsed your-blood from-upon-you, and-I-anointed-you with-oil.

**10** And-I-clothed-you [with]-embroidered-work, and-I-shod-you [with]-fine-leather, and-I-wrapped-you in-fine-linen, and-I-covered-you [with]-silk.

**11** And-I-adorned-you with-ornaments, and-I-put bracelets upon your-hands and-a-chain upon your-neck.

**12** And-I-put a-ring upon your-nose and-earrings upon your-ears and-a-crown-of beauty upon your-head.

**13** And-you-were-adorned [with]-gold and-silver, and-your-clothing [was] fine-linen and-silk and-embroidered-work; fine-flour and-honey and-oil you-ate; and-you-were-beautiful, exceedingly, exceedingly, and-you-prospered to-royalty.

**14** And-your-fame went-out among-the-nations in-your-beauty, for perfect it [was] through-My-splendor which I-had-placed upon-you," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**15** "But-you-trusted in-your-beauty and-played-the-harlot upon your-name, and-you-poured-out your-harlotries upon every passer-by — to-him it-was.

**44** Behold, everyone who-uses-proverbs shall-use this-proverb about-you, saying, 'Like-mother, like-daughter.'

**53** And-I-will-restore their-captivity — the-captivity-of Sodom and-her-daughters, and-the-captivity-of Samaria and-her-daughters, and-the-captivity-of your-captivity in-their-midst,

**54** in-order-that you-bear your-shame and-be-ashamed of-all which you-did in-comforting-them.

**59** For thus says the-Lord YHWH: "I-will-do to-you as you-have-done, who despised the-oath in-breaking the-covenant.

**60** But-I-will-remember My-covenant with-you in-the-days-of your-youth, and-I-will-establish for-you a-covenant everlasting.

**61** And-you-shall-remember your-ways and-be-ashamed, when-you-receive your-sisters, the-greater-than-you along-with the-smaller-than-you, and-I-will-give-them to-you for-daughters, but-not from-your-covenant.

**62** And-I will-establish My-covenant with-you, and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH,

**63** so-that you-remember and-be-ashamed, and-there-will-not-be to-you again opening-of mouth because-of your-shame, when-I-atone for-you for-all which you-did," declares the-Lord YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **16:6**: Va-omar lakh be-damayikh chayi — 'And I said to you in your blood, Live!' Repeated twice for emphasis. The foundling-bride allegory: YHWH rescues an abandoned infant (Jerusalem) from death. This verse is recited at circumcision in Jewish tradition.

- **16:8**: Va-efros kenaph — 'and I spread My skirt/wing.' Marriage imagery (cf. Ruth 3:9). YHWH becomes Jerusalem's husband, transforming the abandoned child into a queen.

- **16:60**: Berit olam — 'an everlasting covenant.' Despite the devastating indictment, YHWH's final word is restoration. The new covenant supersedes the broken one — grace beyond judgment.

— EMET
